top_signals.title: India Economic Growth May Beat RBI’s 6.7% Forecast, Gupta Says
top_signals.summary: India may grow closer to 7% in the financial year through March, stronger than the central bank’s 6.7% forecast, Deputy Governor Poonam Gupta said on Thursday, a pace that would keep it among the world’s fastest-growing major economies.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.

top_signals.summary: MANTRA Chain has halted the network and all transactions after discovering an incident, the nature of which remains undisclosed.
